system.description:
UNQUIET SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000352]{Bloodsoaked} 【Max SL 2】

Whenever an enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points, gain a stacking (SL) bonus damage to your weapon attacks until the end of the scene.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000353]{Defy Fate} 【Max SL 2】

Once per scene, the first time your Hit Points drop below half your Crisis score, after damage resolves but before you would Sacrifice or Surrender, immediately regain (SL x your level) Hit Points and half as many Mind Points.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000354]{Screaming Muscle} 【Max SL 5】

Take an action and spend 5 MP to make a free attack with an equipped heavy melee weapon that loses and cannot gain multi. On a hit, deal (SL x 2) physical damage to up to one other enemy within melee reach (+5 at level 20+, +10 at level 40+). You may spend up to (SL x 2) more MP to inflict dazed on one target of this skill per 5 MP spent.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000355]{Inner Furnace}

You may suffer enraged at will as a free action. Whenever you suffer enraged, you may spend 10 MP to treat your Might die as one size larger (max d12) until you are no longer enraged.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000356]{Tremendous Force} 【Max SL 5】

Once per round when you miss an enemy with a heavy melee weapon (but not on a fumble), spend 10 MP to make a (Might + Willpower) check at DL equal to your missed check's result; on success deal (HR + SL) physical damage to that target. You may spend a Fabula Point to use it again in the same round.
